meta_description: VpnHood is a free, open-source VPN designed to be undetectable, even in restrictive networks — disguising traffic as ordinary browsing to get past firewalls.
phone_alt: VpnHood! CONNECT app on a smartphone
li_secure: Secure by design — modern encryption, fully open source
li_undetectable: Undetectable — evades DPI and VPN-blocking firewalls
li_free_service: Free — no account, no subscription, ad-supported
features_desc: Enjoy secure and private access to the internet, regardless of the websites or applications you use.
f_security_desc: Protect your data with advanced encryption while staying anonymous by hiding your IP address and preventing tracking, ensuring safe, private browsing anywhere, anytime.
f_leak_desc: Stay anonymous with advanced safeguards that prevent any accidental exposure of your IP address or DNS requests.
f_encryption_desc: Protect your data with robust encryption, ensuring secure communication from start to finish.
f_privacy_desc: Experience a smooth, encrypted connection that keeps your online presence confidential across various network environments.
obfuscation_title: Traffic that doesn't look like a VPN
obfuscation_desc: Most VPNs are easy to spot. Deep packet inspection recognizes their protocols on sight, and networks that want to block them simply do. VpnHood shapes its traffic to look like ordinary encrypted browsing — so there's no signature to match, and nothing obvious to throttle or blacklist.
resilient_desc: Our advanced infrastructure is built for maximum uptime. By utilizing dynamic server management and sophisticated protocols, we ensure your secure connection remains active and reliable, providing a seamless browsing experience without interruptions.
open_source_desc1: VpnHood's full source code is public on GitHub. No black-box binaries, no unexplained network calls — inspect it, audit it, or contribute to it yourself.
open_source_desc2: VpnHood underwent a comprehensive security audit by the Open Tech Fund.
options_title: Everything you need in a VPN
options_desc: Gain complete control over your online security and unlock its full potential with advanced options tailored to your specific needs for an optimized, secure experience.
opt_protocols_desc: Including TCP and UDP, optimized for stable and high-speed connectivity.
opt_split_desc: Split traffic by countries, apps, IPs, and domains to save data, boost speed.
opt_dns_desc: Manage how website addresses are resolved by configuring Private DNS and Adapter DNS.
opt_kill_desc: Automatically blocks internet connection immediately if the VPN disconnects.
location_desc: Access our worldwide network of high-speed servers. Connect through multiple global locations to ensure a fast, private, and reliable connection wherever you are.
download_desc: Download our free VPN to access advanced security features. Enhance your digital protection and enjoy a private, encrypted browsing experience anywhere.
windows_note: Note: The Windows app does not have a free server.
